# Module 10: Scenario Assessment {#M10_1 -}

### Objectives {#M10_2 -}

To use the coupled GLM-AED model of a tropical reservoir to build up a water quality model one module at a time, and to explore the feedbacks between dissolved oxygen, nutrients, phytoplankton and zooplankton under different nutrient load scenarios.

### Before you start {#M10_before_start -}

- Complete [Module 9](#M9_1) (GLM Workbook Exercises 1–6), as this module builds on the stratification and water quality concepts covered there

### Module Resources {#M10_3 -}

This week, you'll be working through the [**Tropical Reservoir Water Quality Workbook (GLM-AED)**](TropicalReservoir-Workbook.html){target="_blank"}, using the **TropicalReservoir** case study from the GLM case studies folder.

```{block2, hintM10_1, type='rmdtip2'}
The workbook opens as a separate page in a new tab. Use the menu on its left-hand side to move between the cases.
```

### Exercises {#M10_4 -}

Work through the workbook, setting up a new folder for each case:

-   [Case 0 – Base: Dissolved oxygen](TropicalReservoir-Workbook.html#case0){target="_blank"}
-   [Case 1 – Add nutrients, organic matter and silica](TropicalReservoir-Workbook.html#case1){target="_blank"}
-   [Case 2 – Add diatoms](TropicalReservoir-Workbook.html#case2){target="_blank"}
-   [Case 3 – Three phyto groups](TropicalReservoir-Workbook.html#case3){target="_blank"}
-   [Case 4 – Nutrient load scenarios](TropicalReservoir-Workbook.html#case4){target="_blank"}
-   [Case 5 – Add zooplankton](TropicalReservoir-Workbook.html#case5){target="_blank"} (optional)

### Submission {#M10_5 -}

::: {.redbox2}
**Submit one document that contains:**

-   Answers to all questions in Cases 0–4, numbered by case and question (for example, Case 2 – Q1)
-   The seven plots listed in the workbook's [Final submission](TropicalReservoir-Workbook.html#submission){target="_blank"} section

Case 5 (zooplankton) is optional and does not need to be submitted.

These are to be uploaded as per the formatting specified in the [Style Guide](#StyleGuide). Marks will be deducted for incorrect formatting.
:::
